R441 — Completed CPU diagnostic branch integration audit
Date: 2026-10-14
Mode: source-only, read-only comparison. No edits, Git mutation, builds, tests, AST, GPU/process/environment/log/private JSON actions.

Scope and pins
Repository G: /home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata
J: diag/cpu-job-and-raw-bench-20261012 at d787a19b20c023dbcc2d1d05b404340465f9b895.
Z actual source tree: feat-layer-major-bulk-upload-20261013 at 28a7b9ae7ca5eba28eecd65f6453a7479c04fce8. Stable tested source identity separately supplied: 85cb6b1968bd5c2156eed3b10dbb332f92ee95ac.
The worktree metadata reports J as an ancestor of currentZ, but that ancestry was not treated as proof. Conclusions below come from source-tree symbols, function bodies, build registrations, and blob comparisons. Z is a different worktree/branch from feature/sycl; this report answers the requested J-to-Z actual-tree comparison and does not claim feature/sycl itself has been synchronized.

Decision
No unique, useful CPU diagnostic or paired-kernel source delta from J is missing from Z. The main J outcomes examined are present in the Z source tree:
- opt-in CPU-job histogram/census and its no-GPU plus native-job fixtures;
- the paired IQ3_S gate/up experiment and its parity/geometry fixture;
- bounded host issuer timing and its fixture.
The corresponding build/test registrations are present in Z. Several integration files have later source additions in Z, but the relevant diagnostics and opt-in kernel functions remain. No cherry-pick or file transplant from J is indicated by this comparison.

Feature-by-feature source evidence

1. CPU job census / phase timing.
J's implementation commit f2be61c0 adds CpuJobHistogram, CpuJobHistogramScope, dispatcher observation, request binding, and the native unit fixtures. In Z:
- include/strata/core/expert_source.hpp still declares CpuJobHistogram and CpuJobHistogramScope and the shared observer member.
- src/core/expert_source.cpp retains the same census record/overflow logic, scope binding/finish logic, and observation of expert_pool_dispatch_multi. The source block for CpuJobHistogram from the adapter marker through the report loop was inspected in both trees; it is materially identical. Z has extra service-budget code inserted before it and later line numbers differ.
- src/program/generate.cpp still constructs/binds the census scope and closes it after prompt (cpu_jobs.finish(...), current Z line 9751). Its invocation moved from J line 8624 because Z contains later generation-path changes.
- tests/core/cpu_job_histogram_test.cpp and tests/core/cpu_job_histogram_no_gpu.cpp have identical object IDs in J and Z: 65b7c078247e6ce347aacf258945448e74362007 and 9af2e66c68c39cfad0d623c52d63ea5edc76d967.
- Z CMakeLists.txt retains the cpu_job_histogram_test executable and cpu_job_histogram_off / _on registrations at lines 939-950 (J lines 897-908).
This is an integrated, bounded census; it reports jobs/rows by actual NT but is not CPU service timing. Newer service-budget diagnostic code in Z is complementary, not evidence that this census was deleted or superseded.

2. IQ3_S paired GU experimental kernel.
J's f2be61c0 change adds the STRATA_IQ256_PAIRED_GU opt-in path and iq256_gu_rows_paired_v, with geometry/variant guards. Z retains those symbols and the same dispatch call. The following J/Z object IDs are identical:
- src/kernels/cpu/iq_avx2.cpp: 964be473892ae0b925437a87c0ec54a4a0ad1f35
- src/kernels/cpu/iq_avx2_rows.inl: b8d36a039763e356198317501f4fc0735489844a
- src/kernels/cpu/iq_avx2_parity.cpp: 0cbd17a1b2f4c83f4e70907159bfcc929429b60d
- include/strata/kernels/cpu/iq_avx2.hpp: 240c1d27d54a5554b2837ee96bb776d2d41c2aa7
- tests/core/iq3s_paired_gu_test.cpp: c70ecaff12b3ef33b89b6de293ba040fc1d23ee2
CMakeLists in Z keeps the test target and skip/timeout contract at lines 931-935. This proves the experiment source is included, not that it should be enabled. Prior R436 evidence remains applicable: synthetic paired-GU NT1 was −3.76%, NT8 +2.31%; this does not establish a model-level benefit. The path remains opt-in.

3. Host issuer timing.
J commit 33725508 adds the reusable issuer timing helper, prefill call sites, and the unit fixture. Z has identical objects for:
- include/strata/prefill/issuer_timing.hpp: 356a819c60beb5ad00777fa9885971562d5460f7
- tools/test_prefill_issuer_timing.cpp: 3be571f0d3cd43be3ff1ab14fb467090e58df729
The Z prefill implementation's blob-issue and stager-wait call sites still invoke IssuerTiming::measure/entry and emit the summary. src/prefill/prefill.cpp differs as expected because of newer layer-major implementation, so whole-file equality is not claimed. CMake keeps issuer-timing helper handling and test integration. This diagnostic measures the host issuer/copy submission path; it is distinct from CPU expert GU/Q/Down service clocks.

4. What raw bench contributed.
The latest J commits after the source feature work are 878db80b (qualify native dequant batching and record decode costs), 86f81cdc (retire duplicate CPU diagnostic logs), and d787a19b (retire closed native batch measurement logs). Their raw/model benchmark outputs and retention decisions are evidence artifacts. The source-bearing commits in the relevant diagnostic path are f2be61c0 and 33725508, and their target source/fixtures are present in Z as above. Benchmark receipts themselves are not code integrations and should remain governed by their own artifact-retention/registry status. No result status is upgraded by finding source in Z.

Smallest integration delta and adaptation
There is no source delta to transplant for the identified J features. If someone later needs to reconstruct these features into a different target branch, the smallest source set is:
- Census: expert_source.hpp / expert_source.cpp, generate.cpp integration, CMakeLists.txt, and both cpu_job_histogram fixtures.
- Paired experiment: iq_avx2.hpp, iq_avx2.cpp, iq_avx2_rows.inl, iq_avx2_parity.cpp, CMakeLists.txt, and iq3s_paired_gu_test.cpp.
- Issuer timing: issuer_timing.hpp, prefill.cpp call sites, CMakeLists.txt, and tools/test_prefill_issuer_timing.cpp.
For any other target, adapt generate.cpp line context to its current request/prompt lifecycle and preserve diagnostic opt-in gates; do not copy whole files from J over newer Z. In the requested Z actual tree these deltas are already present, so no transplant is warranted.

Identity checks performed
J and Z file object IDs were compared for all identical-file assertions above. CMake registrations were searched in both tree objects. Census integration points and issuer timing integration points were inspected directly from J and Z blobs. The stable sourceZ hash and currentZ hash are recorded separately above; currentZ, not historical ancestry alone, is the target for source-tree statements.
